_meta.verdict_model: result = LOW if hero <= min (and min>0), HIGH if hero >= max, GOOD strictly between; Bad = LOW or HIGH. Boundaries are CLOSED on both ends, matching leak_engine.classify() and the one observed exact hit ('F to T Pr (HU)' hero=30 vs [30,40] renders LOW).
_meta.rec_action_model: per-stat verb pair chosen by direction: LOW -> '<verb> more', HIGH -> '<verb> less' (verb varies per stat, see rows); GOOD -> 'Good job'

bands.method: Solver-derived, preflop only. Seeded for stats with a clear, defensible monotonic depth trend: Raise First (opens widen as stacks shorten), Fold to Steal and Fold BB v SB (blinds fold more when deeper). 25_40 tracks the harvested 15-40bb blended value; 15_25 is a step off it; lt15 and gte40 are extrapolated and carry NO BBZ anchor — treat as starting points and tune from results. Every other preflop stat inherits the blended target until banded (editable in the /leaks/targets UI).
